amendments: A1 (before any evaluation run; after a single smoke test on seed 42 showed that ranking reserve margin above stop count yields a degenerate buy-every-step plan): tie-break order changed from (margin, stops) to (stops, margin) and 'prefer waiting' added as final tie-break. No evaluation result existed. Smoke tests (one episode each, planner variants x demand scenarios, output not recorded) used seed 42 (reuse set, never a pass/fail input) and seed 10000000 (the first holdout seed; its single-episode outcome was seen, which cannot influence aggregate criteria but is disclosed).

A2 (after the synthetic validation recorded in results/synthetic_validation under criteria hash 79269406..., and before any evaluation of the official checkpoint): (1) numeric decision thresholds moved from prose into 'thresholds', read directly by decision.py/evaluate.py, with the same values the first synthetic run used; (2) the first 1000-episode holdout is reclassified as 'development_holdout' (seen during design and in the synthetic run; kept, not used for decisions) and a new unseen 'confirmation' set is designated for all pass/fail criteria; (3) no planner parameter, metric or criterion logic changed. The first synthetic result is preserved and must not be described as an independent confirmation.

A3 (2026-10-07, before official checkpoint evaluation): record 40000000..40000999 as already used by surrogate confirmation; designate 50000000..50000999 for first official evaluation. Candidate, metrics, thresholds and environment assumptions unchanged. Hash freezes this amended protocol before execution; it does not prove perpetual non-use of a set after execution.
purpose: Decide whether evidence exists to replace the operational DQN with a same-observation planner. This file is fixed before any evaluation run. Changing it after results exist invalidates the verdict; evaluate.py refuses to run if its sha256 differs from criteria.sha256.
units_note: All costs are the repository's Synthetic Cost Index (SCI), a normalized-tank synthetic index. Not a currency; no real saving is claimed.

incumbent.name: double_dqn
incumbent.official_checkpoint_source: GitHub Release asset official-eval-2026-09-01/dqn_final.pt (not in repository; *.pt is gitignored)
incumbent.rule: Only a checkpoint whose sha256 equals the value above counts as the incumbent. Any other checkpoint is a surrogate and forces verdict SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION_ONLY.

candidate.primary_definition: Receding-horizon exact DP over the operational binary refill action, using ONLY the current observation (price, MA30, fx, fuel, route-remaining) plus fixed environment model constants (nominal consumption 0.05/step, refill rule, cap 0.95, reserve 0.15). Price/FX forecast = persistence (current value). Memoryless, like the DQN. Lexicographic objective: (1) safe under assumed consumption, (2) minimum forecast inventory-adjusted cost, (3) fewest stops, (4) maximum minimum reserve margin, (5) prefer waiting. Parameters are fixed here and are not tuned on any evaluation seed.
extensions_reported_not_decided: planner_ops_hist: same, but estimates consumption from the previous observation (uses in-episode observation history; DQN is memoryless)
planner_ops_dl: planner_ops plus knowledge of the deadline (schedule information the DQN does not receive)
planner_fcst_sigma_*: planner given noisy true future price/fx (information the DQN does not receive)
planner_oracle: exact future price/fx (upper bound only; never compared as a replacement candidate)

information_tiers.I_ops: Current 6-dim observation of BunkeringEnv. Shared by DQN and planner_ops.
information_tiers.I_ops_hist: I_ops plus previous observations in the same episode.
information_tiers.I_schedule: I_ops plus the deadline and time overlay constants.
information_tiers.I_forecast: I_ops plus a noisy forecast of future price*fx (sigma grid below).
information_tiers.I_oracle: Exact future price and fx path (upper bound).
information_tiers.rule: A replacement verdict may use ONLY comparisons where candidate information is a subset of the incumbent's I_ops. Tiers beyond I_ops are reported as value-of-information analysis and cannot support replacement.

reuse.role: Existing evaluation path (scripts/evaluate.py plan: base_seed 42, 100 episodes, configs/dqn.yaml env). Used for regression and consistency against results/evaluation_results.csv and scripts.evaluate.run_episode. NOT used for pass/fail: the seeds 42..141 lie inside the default training seed range (seed + episode, 42..5041) and may have been seen in training.

development_holdout.role: DEVELOPMENT evaluation only. Its first seed's single-episode outcome was seen in smoke tests and the full set was used in the first synthetic validation (results/synthetic_validation). Preserved and reported, never used for pass/fail, and not an independent confirmation.

confirmation.role: Official pass/fail confirmation set, designated under A3 before this run. No known prior use at designation. After execution record it as used; do not describe it as perpetually unseen.
confirmation.disjointness_check: Seeds must not intersect [train_seed, train_seed + n_episodes) read from checkpoint metadata, the reuse seeds, the development holdout, or any range in seed_ranges_already_used.

seed_ranges_already_used.use: diagnostic: price*fx drift of the env under no-op, no policy
diagnostic: planner_ops vs surrogate DQN cost difference
surrogate confirmation; candidate outcomes already observed

env_scenarios.note: Demand error is realized by changing the environment's true consumption while policies keep the nominal 0.05 model. Demand is constant per leg in BunkeringEnv; leg-by-leg demand variation is not modelled (documented limitation).

time_overlay.status: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER. BunkeringEnv has no clock or deadline. These constants are assumptions, not data.

classes.sailing_exceeds_deadline: legs * leg_hours > deadline: sailing alone misses the deadline. Counted separately, excluded from compliance denominators, no claim made. Speed/route change would be a separate extension needing extra assumptions; not implemented as a decision input.
classes.stop_forced_exceeds_deadline: sailing fits but the minimum number of stops needed for safe arrival (computed by DP for the scenario) exceeds the stops the deadline allows. Counted separately, excluded from compliance denominators.
classes.attainable: deadline allows at least the minimum safe stop count. Time compliance is judged only here.

metrics.safety: VoyageAudit.safe_arrival (arrived, no pre-refill shortage, no pre-refill reserve violation with reserve = env.min_safe_fuel = 0.15)
metrics.cost_primary: inventory_adjusted_sci from VoyageAudit, compared pairwise over episodes where BOTH policies are safe arrivals
metrics.cost_secondary_reported: raw cumulative_cost_index (no terminal inventory credit; biased toward under-buying) and cost over all episodes
metrics.time: on_time_safe_arrival rate within the attainable class, per deadline scenario
metrics.runtime: per-decision wall time of select_action (perf_counter_ns), single process, CPU; p50, p99, mean; plus episode wall time

statistics.interval: percentile interval with endpoints thresholds.ci_percentiles; non-inferiority is judged against the relevant bound
statistics.note: No multiplicity correction is applied; because every required criterion must pass, the decision rule is conservative in the AND direction.

gates.G1_official_incumbent: incumbent checkpoint sha256 equals the official value
gates.G2_holdout_disjoint: confirmation seeds disjoint from checkpoint training seed range, reuse seeds, development holdout and seed_ranges_already_used
gates.G3_criteria_hash: criteria.json sha256 equals criteria.sha256 at evaluation time
gates.G5_reuse_consistency: runner reproduces scripts.evaluate.run_episode exactly on the reuse set for the incumbent and the three rule baselines
gates.failure_verdict: NOT_DECIDABLE (any gate fails) ; SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION_ONLY (G1 fails because incumbent is a surrogate)

replacement_criteria.applies_to: planner_ops versus incumbent, I_ops only, confirmation set

R1_safety.pass_if: planner fuel_depleted episodes <= thresholds.candidate_max_depleted AND lower interval bound of (planner safe rate - incumbent safe rate) >= thresholds.safety_lower_bound

R2_cost.pass_if: joint-safe share >= thresholds.min_joint_safe_share AND upper interval bound of relative paired difference (mean(planner - incumbent) / mean(incumbent) on inventory_adjusted_sci) <= thresholds.cost_upper_bound
R2_cost.superiority_label: cost superior if the upper bound < 0; otherwise non-inferior only

R3_time.pass_if: for every deadline scenario in the attainable class: lower interval bound of (planner on_time_safe rate - incumbent on_time_safe rate) >= thresholds.time_lower_bound; classes sailing_exceeds_deadline and stop_forced_exceeds_deadline are tabulated separately and do not enter pass/fail

R4_runtime.pass_if: planner per-decision p99 <= thresholds.runtime_p99_ms on the measuring machine; ratio to incumbent reported for information only

R5_demand_robustness.pass_if: in each required scenario, lower interval bound of (planner safe rate - incumbent safe rate) >= thresholds.demand_safety_lower_bound (the zero-depletion clause of R1 is not required here)

replacement_criteria.R6_forecast_error: Not a replacement criterion. Forecast sensitivity is a value-of-information analysis: report the cost advantage of forecast planners over planner_ops versus sigma, and the break-even sigma* where the paired 95 percent interval no longer excludes zero advantage. A forecast-based replacement needs a separate evaluation in which the incumbent receives the same forecast.

verdicts.REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT: all gates pass and R1-R5 pass. This is evidence for a human decision, not a deployment, replacement, or merge.
verdicts.REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: all gates pass and at least one of R1-R5 fails
verdicts.NOT_DECIDABLE: a gate other than G1 fails
verdicts.SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION_ONLY: G1 fails (surrogate incumbent); numbers validate the harness only and say nothing about the operational DQN

surrogate_for_synthetic_validation.note: Training seeds 5000000..5002999 are disjoint from reuse and holdout seeds. The surrogate is NOT the official model.

thresholds._note: Single source of truth. decision.py and evaluate.py read these values; the prose in replacement_criteria refers to them by name.
